jobs.title: Director Project Management Office (m-w-d)
jobs.notes: Dream company, bumped B to A. Builds the Project Management Office for a global business unit: defines the project management framework, methods and work instructions, introduces a new Project Business Operating Model with change management, acts as Business Process Expert for project management at group level, has people responsibility and sits in the leadership team. Asks for strong process management and framework design for global functions. Verified live 2026-11-24 (over 100 clicked apply). Gaps: wants extensive large-project delivery with P&L responsibility in critical industries (defence, aerospace, rail), fluent German, salary not stated.

jobs.title: Director Enterprise Planning and Transformation (m/f/d)
jobs.notes: Re-verified live 2026-11-24 (66 clicked apply, up from 10). Dream company. Owns business process architecture, SIOP and the transformation portfolio. Gaps: on-site, wants SIOP experience, salary not stated.

jobs.title: Abteilungsleitung CIO/COO Office - Strategy, Governance & Performance (m/w/d)
jobs.notes: Newly created department head role reporting to the CIO/COO board member. Owns strategy, governance, performance management, portfolio and capacity steering and the target operating model across IT, Operations, Banking Services, Credit Services and Procurement, including end-to-end processes, automation and AI. Verified live 2026-11-24 (18 clicked apply). Gaps: banking IT setting, asks for knowledge of DORA and MaRisk and around 7 years in a comparable strategic steering role, salary not stated.

jobs.title: Leiter (m/w/d) Organization (Layer 3)

Verified live 2026-11-24 (5 clicked apply). Gaps: insurance and HR-adjacent (job architecture, grading), work model not stated, salary not stated.

jobs.title: Director of Industrialisation
jobs.notes: Target company, bumped C to B. Verified live 2026-11-24 (47 clicked apply). Gaps: requires having personally led a greenfield site through ramp-up, on-site, early-stage defence start-up so pay level is unknown (inferred risk).

Verified live 2026-11-24 (10 clicked apply). Gaps: quality management officer profile (ISO 9001/EN9100, AQAP, DO-178), reads more operational than strategic, salary not stated.
